For India-
Disprz uses the Azure Central Region (Pune) as the primary DC and the Azure South Region (Chennai) as the backup.
For SEA region- Disprz uses the Azure Singapore Region for hosting customer data of all SEA clients. | | 3 | Why disprz uses multi-cloud platform? | It was an architectural decision taken to serve different purposes. 80% of the relational data resides in Azure and 20% of non-relational data & non-PII data are stored in AWS. | | 4 | Is the application accessible over internet and mobile? | Yes, Disprz application is accessible through internet and mobile (Android and iOS). The supported web browsers include Chrome, MS Edge, Firefox and Safari. | | 5 | Where the customer data is stored? | All the relational data (customer data- user data, user activities, modules meta data, journey, quiz, certificate, leaderboard etc.) are stored in the Azure whereas AWS stores, Videos and Non Relational data such as Push notifications. Images are stored in the Azure blob storage. | | 6 | What are the frontend and backend technologies used in the platform? | **Frontend** \- ReactJS, CSS, HTML, Javascript
**Backend** \- [![](https://www.microsoft.com/favicon.ico?v2)Microsoft – AI, Cloud, Productivity, Computing, Gaming & Apps](http://microsoft.net/) , C# and Azure SQL. | | 7 | What application server does your application run in? | Disprz production systems are on Windows Servers 2019. Both Web and APIs are deployed on Windows Server 2019. | | 8 | What are the services opted from the CSPs for IDS?IPS? | For DMZ, IDS/IPS, firewall, Disprz uses cloud based services of Azure Front Door, WAF and other CSP provided tools to avoid security threats. | | 9 | Are there dependencies on software or hardware for accessing the disprz application? | Being a SaaS-based LMS solution provider, we are using virtualized PaaS environment from CSPs (Azure/AWS). Since the platform is accessible through web browsers and mobile apps, there are no dependencies on hardware or software components for the customer to use the solution | | 10 | How do you monitor server performance? | We use Azure Application Insights system for the server performance metrics. All our production servers are integrated with Azure Application insights and the logs are monitored continuously. | | 11 | Do you follow security hardening for servers, network components of the cloud infrastructure? | No, AWS/Azure takes care of the maintenance of network architecture and security as part of the PaaS offering, which also includes security hardening for all underlying server components of the cloud infrastructure. | Collapse action bar View all comments Open Details Panel Open Rovo Chat Add a comment Add labels Add a reaction {"serverDuration": 31, "requestCorrelationId": "745e5390907a4c138fc0667f182377a8"}
